description: Every compute host function, once. Server dispatchers, the capability summary, the SDK parity gate and the CrowdyJS browser broker are all checked against this file (DN-10: grid scope = app scope intersected with grid confinement).

groups.model: Game Model containers, properties, edges and function invocation
groups.state: Durable user / avatar / grid state blobs

functions.name: container_create
functions.grid: Created on the player tier, owned by the executing identity and tagged with the grid

functions.name: container_get
functions.grid: Only containers the executing identity owns on this grid; others are unavailable

functions.name: container_get_batch
functions.app: Up to 32 containers in the app
functions.grid: Up to 32 owned containers on this grid; foreign ids are silently absent

functions.name: container_get_by_key
functions.app: One container by type, session and binding key
functions.grid: Not offered; player grids have no binding keys

functions.name: model_invoke
functions.grid: Ordinary player path as the executing identity; no worldWrites

functions.name: edge_add
functions.app: Any two containers in the app
functions.grid: Both endpoints owned on this grid

functions.name: edge_delete
functions.grid: Edges between owned containers on this grid

functions.name: sessions_list
functions.grid: Sessions whose gridId is this grid

functions.name: avatar_state_get
functions.grid: Avatars whose live actor is inside the grid

functions.name: actors_list_radius
functions.grid: Centre inside the grid box; the box is clipped to the grid

functions.name: voxel_set
functions.grid: Chunks inside the grid box, and update_voxel_data on the grid

functions.name: grid_permission_check
functions.app: Any user and grid in the app
functions.grid: The executing identity on this grid

functions.name: grid_info
functions.grid: The binding's own grid id and box, answered locally

functions.name: emit_spatial
functions.grid: Origin chunk inside the grid box; reach is min(distance, 8, spatial_max_distance)

functions.name: emit_channel
functions.grid: Channels of this grid (channel_egress='grid'), or channels the owner may send_messages on (channel_egress='send_messages')

functions.name: emit_event
functions.grid: The grid event bus: modules on this grid, and app modules with a grid_event trigger
